Managing LLM Providers for AI Guard
Ask Zscaler

Adding Large Language Model (LLM) providers in AI Guard is one of the necessary tasks when configuring AI Guard in Proxy mode. LLM providers are the services that generate context-aware responses that mimic interactions with humans in AI applications.

After you add the LLM provider, you must add LLM provider credentials. AI Guard uses these credentials to authenticate with the LLM provider. To learn more, see Managing LLM Provider Credentials for AI Guard.

Adding LLM Providers

To add an LLM provider:

In the AI Guard left-side navigation under LLMs, click Provider. The Providers page appears, listing any providers added for your organization.

See image.

On the Providers page, click Add More. The Add LLM Provider window appears.

In the Add LLM Provider window:

Provider Name: Enter a name for the provider to identify the provider on our platform.
Provider Type: From the drop-down menu, select your desired provider.
Deployment: Select if you want the deployment to be Public or Private.
Server: Depending on the Provider Type you selected, you may need to select your specific server from the drop-down menu.

See image.

Click Submit.
Editing LLM Providers

To edit an LLM provider:

In the AI Guard left-side navigation under LLMs, click Provider. The Providers page appears, listing all the providers for your organization.

See image.

In the Action column next to an LLM provider, click the Edit icon. The Add LLM Provider window appears.

In the Add LLM Provider window, change any of the fields for the provider.

See image.

Click Submit.
